description: Implementation of the android::ProcessState class managing binder IPC process state, thread pool, driver interactions, and process lifecycle.

classes.name: PoolThread
classes.description: A thread class that joins the binder thread pool, used internally by ProcessState.

methods.name: self
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProcessState.

methods.name: initWithDriver
methods.description: Initializes ProcessState with a specific driver.

methods.name: selfOrNull
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance or null if not initialized.

methods.name: getContextObject
methods.description: Retrieves the context object for the process.

methods.name: onFork
methods.description: Handles post-fork logic to prevent usage after fork.

methods.name: parentPostFork
methods.description: Post-fork handling for parent process.

methods.name: childPostFork
methods.description: Post-fork handling for child process, cleans up driver handle.

methods.name: startThreadPool
methods.description: Starts the binder thread pool.

methods.name: becomeContextManager
methods.description: Attempts to make the process a binder context manager.

methods.name: getKernelReferences
methods.description: Retrieves kernel-held references for debugging.

methods.name: getStrongRefCountForNode
methods.description: Gets the strong reference count for a binder node.

methods.name: setCallRestriction
methods.description: Sets call restrictions for IPC threads.

methods.name: lookupHandleLocked
methods.description: Looks up a handle in the handle-to-object map.

methods.name: getStrongProxyForHandle
methods.description: Returns a strong proxy IBinder for a handle.

methods.name: expungeHandle
methods.description: Removes a handle from the handle map.

methods.name: makeBinderThreadName
methods.description: Generates a name for binder threads.

methods.name: spawnPooledThread
methods.description: Creates and runs a new binder thread.

methods.name: setThreadPoolMaxThreadCount
methods.description: Sets maximum number of binder threads.

methods.name: getThreadPoolMaxTotalThreadCount
methods.description: Returns total max thread count for thread pool.

methods.name: isThreadPoolStarted
methods.description: Checks if thread pool has been started.

methods.name: isDriverFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific driver feature is enabled.

methods.name: enableOnewaySpamDetection
methods.description: Enables or disables oneway spam detection.

methods.name: giveThreadPoolName
methods.description: Sets the current thread's name to the binder thread name.

methods.name: getDriverName
methods.description: Returns the driver name.

methods.name: open_driver
methods.description: Opens the binder driver device and verifies protocol version.
